dependency_edges.handoff: Cleaned rows feed the LDA diagnostic.
Report coordinates and counts feed the population proxy.
Suitability and grid values feed the CA.
CA population feeds Bayes event probabilities.
Bayes events and report images feed the image benchmark.
Regional credibility feeds the weighted score.
Weighted priority feeds SIR and field review.
CA output supplies the eradication branch.
Alpha score and uncertainty feed the memo handoff.
